subject: [PATCH 23/60] mm/damon: restrict DAMON-native folio operations to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original patch author posted two identical messages, which are likely due to a relay issue. The content is clear and concise, but there's no discussion or feedback from other reviewers.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts DAMON-native folio operations to common memory, treating them like ZONE_DEVICE memory. This change is necessary because DAMON cannot acquire folios outside N_MEMORY_COMMON, which would lead to incorrect behavior in virtual address monitoring and migration.

reviews.author: Yury Norov
reviews.summary: Requested a smaller diff to improve patch readability and suggested removing unnecessary code changes.
reviews.raw_body:
On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 01:09:14PM -0500, Gregory Price via B4 Relay wrote:
> From: "Gregory Price (Meta)" <gourry@gourry.net>
> 
> DAMON acquires folios to age them, check their accesses, and apply LRU
> operations and migration. Treat these as general-purpose MM services
> and restrict them to N_MEMORY_COMMON.
> 
> Memory outside N_MEMORY_COMMON can still hold ordinary LRU folios, so
> it would pass the checks that keep ZONE_DEVICE memory out of these
> operations.
> 
> Treat these folios like ZONE_DEVICE memory.
> 
> DAMON cannot acquire such a folio, so it never ages one and virtual
> address monitoring reports it as accessed, and DAMOS cannot isolate
> one for migration.
> 
> Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>
> ---
>  mm/damon/ops-common.c | 5 +++--
>  mm/damon/vaddr.c      | 2 +-
>  2 files changed, 4 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)
> 
> diff --git a/mm/damon/ops-common.c b/mm/damon/ops-common.c
> index 15cabc79613b..57201a0c5e3a 100644
> --- a/mm/damon/ops-common.c
> +++ b/mm/damon/ops-common.c
> @@ -17,8 +17,9 @@
>  
>  static bool damon_folio_acceptable(struct folio *folio, bool monitor)
>  {
> -	return folio_test_lru(folio) ||
> -		(monitor && folio_test_hugetlb(folio));
> +	return folio_is_common_memory(folio) &&
> +		(folio_test_lru(folio) ||
> +		 (monitor && folio_test_hugetlb(folio)));

Can you minimize the diff? That would also improve on readability IMO:

        if (!folio_is_common_memory())
                return false;

	return folio_test_lru(folio) ||
		(monitor && folio_test_hugetlb(folio));
>  }
>  
>  /*
> diff --git a/mm/damon/vaddr.c b/mm/damon/vaddr.c
> index 1e65e7651cd9..338876559140 100644
> --- a/mm/damon/vaddr.c
> +++ b/mm/damon/vaddr.c
> @@ -830,7 +830,7 @@ static void damos_va_migrate_dests_add(struct folio *folio,
>  	if (folio_nid(folio) == nid)
>  		return;
>  
> -	if (!folio_isolate_lru(folio))
> +	if (!folio_is_common_memory(folio) || !folio_isolate_lru(folio))
>  		return;
>  	node_stat_add_folio(folio, NR_ISOLATED_ANON +
>  			folio_is_file_lru(folio));
> 
> -- 
> 2.56.1
>

2026-11-22.patch_summary: This patch restricts DAMON-native folio operations to common memory, treating them like ZONE_DEVICE memory. This change prevents DAMON from acquiring and aging non-common memory folios, which would otherwise be reported as accessed by virtual address monitoring.
